decision.decision_context: Director agreed with Design Sol's F2 preference after reviewing complete visual artworks representing F1 and F2 in representative app context.

reasoning_summary: F2 reads quieter, stranger and more distinctly Kymaean while allowing the dark Stage to remain the emotional center.
F1 remains valid but carries the previously recorded premium editorial / heritage genericity reservation.
F2's violet/teal creative-tool familiarity risk remains active and requires sparse accent use rather than saturation or decorative spread.

artwork_role.note: The complete generated F1/F2 artworks informed color-world and emotional-temperature judgment only. Their invented imagery, icons, component details and density are not architecture authority and are not adopted as UI implementation.

authority_created: F2 Monochrome + Intruder is the selected Phase-3 CLR color-logic direction.
The frozen F2 APP role values are the reference input to the Light/Dark translation successor study.
authority_not_created: No production color tokens or final palette are frozen.
No semantic status-color system is created.
No dark-theme tokens are invented by this selection.
No component, imagery, iconography, motion, native implementation or Phase-3 convergence authority is created.
next_boundary: Derive and falsify a Light/Dark F2 translation on the accepted representative Home scaffold. Light/Dark must preserve identical semantic hierarchy, Stage darkness, focus != selection, sparse accent discipline, forced-colors comprehension and non-color-dependent state meaning before any production-token claim.
